01-browse-and-cart.name: 01-browse-and-cart
01-browse-and-cart.title: Browse the catalogue and add items to the cart

steps.heading: Browse the catalogue
steps.detail:
Opened the shop’s home page and reviewed the catalogue.
The catalogue displayed four products, with a visible name and price for each product.
The requested catalogue review was completed successfully.

steps.heading: Add a product to the cart
steps.detail:
Added the first product to the cart as requested.
The cart badge in the header updated to show 1 item, confirming the product was added.

steps.heading: Add a second product
steps.detail:
Added a different product to the cart as requested.
Confirmed that the cart badge in the header now shows 2 items.

02-checkout-order.name: 02-checkout-order
02-checkout-order.title: Check out and get an order number

steps.heading: Open checkout with an item
steps.detail:
Added the Field Notebook to the cart.
Recorded the added item as Field Notebook, priced at $18.00.
Opened the checkout page, where Field Notebook and its $18.00 price were shown in the item list.

steps.heading: Read the order summary
steps.detail:
Reviewed the order summary on the checkout page as requested.
Confirmed that the listed Field Notebook price matched the $18.00 subtotal.
Confirmed shipping was $5.00 and the total correctly included the subtotal plus shipping ($23.00).

steps.heading: Pay by card
steps.detail:
Completed the requested payment form using the provided test name, email, card number, future expiry date, and CVC, along with required test details.
Placed the order successfully.
The confirmation page displayed order number INK-45696.

03-promo-save10.name: 03-promo-save10
03-promo-save10.title: Apply the SAVE10 promo code at checkout

steps.heading: Open checkout with an item
steps.detail:
Added a product to the cart as requested.
Went to the checkout page.
The checkout order summary displayed Subtotal, Shipping, and Total.

steps.heading: Apply the promo code
steps.detail:
Applied the promo code SAVE10 during checkout.
The order summary showed a $1.80 discount, confirming that the code was applied successfully.

steps.heading: Check the new total
steps.detail:
The checkout page is not displaying a Total line after the discount and shipping charges are shown.
Restore a visible Total row in the checkout order summary and calculate it as Subtotal minus Discount plus $5.00 shipping.
evidence: objective_contradiction: The order summary lacks a visible Total, so the required checkpoint cannot be satisfied.

04-order-history.name: 04-order-history
04-order-history.title: Find a placed order under Account → Orders

steps.heading: Place an order
steps.detail:
Added a product to the cart and proceeded to checkout.
Entered the requested test contact and payment details, along with required checkout information.
Placed the order successfully.
The confirmation displayed order number INK-41416.

steps.heading: Open the order history
steps.detail:
The agent assumed the store name would open an account page and then checked the cart instead. Those visible links led to the storefront and checkout, not to an Account or Orders area.
Update the run to use a real Account/Orders entry point, or change the test setup so it targets an application that provides those pages. Do not use the store name or Cart link as substitutes for account navigation. (Checked storefront and checkout navigation; neither exposes an Account or Orders route.)

bugVerdict.title: Agent mistook storefront links for account navigation
bugVerdict.oneLiner: The run could not reach Orders because this storefront only exposed its shop and cart links, and the agent treated those links as account navigation.
